requirements.title: Receive Heart-Rate Measurement
requirements.description: The system shall receive heart-rate measurements from a connected monitoring device.
requirements.rationale: Heart-rate measurements must be received before the system can evaluate the patient's condition.

requirements.title: Associate Measurement with Patient
requirements.description: The system shall associate each received heart-rate measurement with the correct patient using a unique patient identifier.
requirements.rationale: Each measurement must be processed and recorded for the correct patient.

requirements.title: Evaluate Heart-Rate Measurement
requirements.description: The system shall compare each received heart-rate measurement against the configured minimum and maximum thresholds for the associated patient.
requirements.rationale: The system must determine whether the patient's heart rate is within the configured acceptable range.

requirements.title: Detect Abnormal Heart Rate
requirements.description: The system shall classify a heart-rate measurement as abnormal when it is below the configured minimum threshold or above the configured maximum threshold.
requirements.rationale: Abnormal measurements must be identified before an alert can be generated.

requirements.title: Notify Assigned Nurse
requirements.description: The system shall send an alert to the patient's assigned nurse when an abnormal heart-rate measurement is detected.
requirements.rationale: The responsible nurse must be informed when the system detects an abnormal patient condition.

requirements.title: Acknowledge Alert
requirements.description: The system shall allow the assigned nurse to acknowledge an abnormal-heart-rate alert.
requirements.rationale: The system must know whether an alert has been received and handled by the assigned nurse.

requirements.title: Escalate Unacknowledged Alert
requirements.description: The system shall escalate an abnormal-heart-rate alert if the assigned nurse has not acknowledged it within 60 seconds.
requirements.rationale: Critical abnormal events must not remain unattended when the assigned nurse does not respond.

requirements.title: Support Multiple Patients
requirements.description: The system shall support simultaneous monitoring of multiple patients.
requirements.rationale: The system is intended to monitor multiple hospitalized patients at the same time.

requirements.title: Register Patient
requirements.description: The system shall allow an authorized user to register a patient for heart-rate monitoring.
requirements.rationale: Patient monitoring information must exist before measurements can be associated with a patient.

requirements.title: Configure Patient Thresholds
requirements.description: The system shall allow an authorized user to configure minimum and maximum heart-rate thresholds for each patient.
requirements.rationale: Different patients may require different monitoring thresholds.

requirements.title: Record Abnormal Event
requirements.description: The system shall store every detected abnormal heart-rate event.
requirements.rationale: Abnormal events must be available for later clinical review and system traceability.

requirements.title: Store Abnormal Event Information
requirements.description: The system shall store the patient identifier, heart-rate value, timestamp, severity, and notification status for every abnormal event.
requirements.rationale: Sufficient event information is required to understand and review abnormal monitoring events.

requirements.title: Retain Monitoring Records
requirements.description: The system shall retain stored monitoring records for a configurable retention period.
requirements.rationale: Record retention requirements may vary depending on organizational and regulatory needs.

requirements.title: Process Five-Second Measurements
requirements.description: The system shall process heart-rate measurements received from each monitoring device at five-second intervals.
requirements.rationale: Heart-rate measurements must be evaluated frequently enough to detect abnormalities in a timely manner.

requirements.title: Detect Device Disconnection
requirements.description: The system shall generate a technical alert when a monitoring device becomes disconnected or stops providing heart-rate measurements.
requirements.rationale: A disconnected monitoring device may prevent the system from detecting a patient's abnormal heart rate.

requirements.title: Restrict Patient Data Access
requirements.description: The system shall restrict access to patient monitoring information to authorized users.
requirements.rationale: Patient monitoring information must be protected from unauthorized access.
